A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point he found himself cornered by three hostile armored beings - a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] and a Human - and used his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to call for reinforcements.

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Reinforcements" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artist [[Darren Tan]].
